1. 
I will treat as confidential any of Serco’s proprietary information or that of a third party that is
stored on “my.serco.com” by Serco and gained by me during the course of this engagement and
agree not to disclose this information to any third party and not to use any of this information for
any reasons other than those required by Serco. I acknowledge that Serco retains the proprietary
rights to any of its information disclosed to me.

2. 
I shall for the duration of this work hold the assembled materials or data compiled in a secure
manner in either paper and/or electronic format and agree to return immediately any such
materials or data on the conclusion or termination of this engagement or at any time at the request
of Serco, confirming in writing that I have not knowingly retained any materials or data.
